protocol.statistics: Best native cut of three trials; median per-trial process wall time from the same three runs; not time to the best-of-three cut

stopping: Frozen observable rule; original-QUBO terminal verification followed by explicit CPU refinement; no benchmark reference used to stop

selection.scope: All30 paper inputs; one preselected trajectory per setting; FP32 and exact conditional-QUBO postprocessing; three independent repeats
selection.stopping: Warmup1024, patience512, turnover<=0.001 and variance<=0.02; final-penalty zero-catalyst verification64+ updates; no optimality certificate
selection.selection: Policies unchanged from the preceding full30 latency cohort. No selection using the new evaluation outcomes.
